Commercial Door Stop Holder - DonJo 1514

This is a sturdy door holder for many commercial needs, including heavy industrial applications.

When closing the door, the catch slips in automatically. With a simple push of a finger, you can unclasp the catch and open the door. Its cast brass material means it will last for many durable years. Easy to use, it can be quite handy around the office, home, or shop.

Doorstop Don-Jo 1514 Door Catch Hold Features:

  • Projection: 3-1/2"
  • Dimensions: 2" x 2"x 1/4"
  • Cast Brass material
  • Includes new hardware for installation

This is available in one finish, Satin Chrome.
